name: Pass word to IntelliSense schedule
description:
## Summary

The user requested a modification to the Chat.vue component to improve the IntelliSense search triggering mechanism. The solution involved refactoring the `scheduleIntelliSense()` and `runIntelliSense()` methods to accept an optional `word` parameter, eliminating the need to manually update the cursor word state. This change was applied to the `onSelectionSearchFiles()` method, allowing it to directly pass the search word to IntelliSense and avoid timing synchronization issues. The implementation follows Vue component best practices with proper method signatures and maintains backward compatibility by making the word parameter optional with a default value of null.
